name: Rowan
title: Keeper of the Gate Book
examine: Forty years of Dawnmead weather in his face and a traveling cloak he finally earned the honest way. The pen looks small in his hands. The book does not.
lines: Forty years I told wakers the road would ask for them one day. Two winters back it finally asked for me.
Every name that walks north goes in the book. Every name that walks back gets a mark. I read the unmarked ones more than I should.
Wren keeps the Ring now. She writes weekly and pretends it's about the weather. It is never about the weather.
